messages:
Alex: seeing a sudden 5xx spike on /v1/generate from partner-x. majority routed to model-alpha.
Priya: on it. logs show long-context requests from partner-x causing kernel OOMs on model-alpha.
Marta: we can do a quick traffic steering override; suggest move partner-x to model-beta at 65%.
Alex: prefer header match so global routing unchanged. match on `x-client-id: partner-x` and only adjust weights for that header.
Jen: will avoid console click ops — use control API so it's auditable. example payload I used in staging:
Jen: ```
POST /v1/routing/overrides
Auth: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN
{
  "match": {"headers": {"x-client-id": "partner-x"}},
  "actions": [{"type": "weight_adjust", "weights": {"model-alpha": 35, "model-beta": 65}}],
  "meta": {"reason": "hotfix - model-alpha OOM long seqs", "incident": "INC-4217", "creator": "jen"}
}
```
Priya: I'll apply that now. can someone prepare a one-command rollback and an auto-revert trigger?
Marta: rollback = delete override or set weights back. quick delete script:
Marta: ```
# revert-ovr.sh
curl -X DELETE "https://control.redwood.internal/v1/routing/overrides/ovr-9d2a" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
deploy-bot: override applied -> id=ovr-9d2a, creator=jen, created_at=1767777830
Priya: override live @1767777830 for header x-client-id:partner-x. traffic shifted.
Priya: initial telemetry: partner-x model-alpha 5xx down from 24% -> 3% within 2m.
Jen: latency looks stable; model-beta CPU rose but within margin.
Marta: set orchestration guard: if model-beta 5xx > 7% for 5m then automatic revert. added rule.
Alex: annotate incident runbook: call this "weight surgery" under INC-4217. stash API payload and rollback command in runbook.
Priya: saving route snapshot to s3://redwood-dumps/INC-4217/route-snapshot-1767777830.json
inc-bot: incident INC-4217 updated: status=traffic_shifted, commander=Priya
Jen: opening follow-up: add unit/regression test to CI that simulates long sequence to catch OOM.
Marta: will PR default routing fallback to prefer header-specific overrides over global weights.
Priya: keeping override for 45m while we patch model-alpha. will post revert timestamp here.
Alex: thumbs up. after stable patch we plan progressive rollback: 65/35 -> 50/50 -> original across 2 hours.
Priya: monitoring on. ping me if you see anything weird. :eyes:
